mostWorthwhile.text: Activating the matching lymphocyte and seeing its descendants become antibody-making and memory cells was worthwhile because it connected recognition to two different outcomes.

leastWorthwhile.text: Making and attaching the antibodies felt predictable once the matching shapes and protein building blocks were shown, though it helped complete the sequence.

surprise.text: The activated cell produced both antibody-making cells and lasting memory cells; I had not expected the two roles to appear together.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt especially arbitrary. The pictures and earlier explanation gave a purpose for each pairing, although the helper's supplied role meant I did not have to figure out how to provide it.

continue.text: I would choose to try another chapter: following the matching shapes through to bacteria being cleared made the process understandable, even if some pairings were predictable.
